fact: Disconnect the computer from the power source before disassembling it.
Use an antistatic wrist strap when handling internal components.
Document and label cables before disconnecting them.
Organize screws in a labeled container.
Keep the work area clean and orderly.
Random-access memory stores data temporarily while programs are running.
The motherboard connects and supports internal computer components.
The power supply provides electrical power to internal parts.
The operating system manages hardware and provides a platform for other software.
A device driver lets the operating system communicate with hardware devices.
